stage2_patch.explanation: Inserted the project's existing admin authentication guard at the very top of admin/editnews2.jsp, immediately after the page directive `<%@page contentType="text/html"%>`. The guard includes `auth.jsp` to initialize the `drhlLoggedIn` session flag as the project does, then checks that `drhlLoggedIn` is not null and equals "true". Unauthenticated visitors and ordinary users are redirected to `index.jsp` and the request is terminated with `return` before any parameter handling or SQL update. Authorized admins (drhlLoggedIn == "true") pass through and the original business logic is preserved unchanged.
